opportunities.title: Regular Grant (under £100,000)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, charitable incorporated organisations (CIOs), exempt and excepted charities; must have at least one year of annual accounts.
opportunities.summary: Grants of up to £100,000 for operating/core costs, capital projects or specific activities. Applications are accepted all year round with no set deadline.

opportunities.title: Major Grant (£100,000 and over)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Organisation must have annual income over £1 million or total project/capital costs over £1 million; UK registered charities, CIOs, exempt and excepted charities; must have at least one year of annual accounts.
opportunities.summary: Major Grants of £100,000 and above for capital, project or core costs. Applications (Expression of Interest) are accepted all year round with no set deadline; considered at one of eight Board meetings per year.
